verdict.rationale: cubic exposes a lot programmatically: an MCP server that reads review findings and codebase context, requests PR reviews, triages scan issues, and manages subscription and seats; an Analytics API for PR-level data; a CLI for local reviews; and cubic.yaml as config-as-code for review behavior and custom agents. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose API covering the full UI surface, and OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Several UI features have no documented API path, including the stacked-PR merge UI, chat sidebar, codebase scan launch, wiki management and dashboard settings. Missing for 10: a documented general REST/OpenAPI spec, an explicit UI–API parity statement, API coverage for stack merging, scan launch, chat and settings, and independent corroboration.
